text.description_html:
Laurey 57120, Transitional Newport 96mm Cabinet Pull in Matte Black

The Small Matte Black Newport Cabinet Pull has 96mm center to centers. The Transitional Newport 96mm Cabinet Pull in Matte Black comes packaged with mounting hardware. The 96mm Newport Pull Matte Black can be used as a kitchen cabinet pull or also in the bathroom or on furniture.

This transitional cabinet pull is part of the Laurey Newport Collection.

Specifications and Features of the Laurey 57120 96mm Pull Newport Matte Black:

  • Material: Zinc
  • Finish: Matte Black
  • Length c.c. (center to center): 3.78" (96mm)
  • Overall Length: 4.61"
  • Width: 0.41"
  • Projection: 1.18"
  • Packaged with 1" long #8-32 screws and 1-1/2" long #8-32 screws.
